header: How customers rated us, criterion by criterion
lead: Six questions on a five-point scale. Two of the six have improved since 2024, one has got worse, and the one that got worse is the one about price.
note: 2,400 replies to a survey sent to 9,000 customers in September 2026. The overall score is the weighted figure published in the annual report and is not the average of the six rows below; the rows are unweighted means.

metrics.title: Online portal
metrics.text: Up from 3.9 in 2024, after the rebuild.

metrics.title: Value for money
metrics.text: Down from 3.7 in 2024. Prices rose 11 % over the same period.
